per_shot.note: Warm hab reads well and the lit GALLERY doorway with magenta spill promises the wing, but the floor carries soft orange/pink blur blobs (incl. a stray one mid-floor left of the suit) that read as smudges, not light.
Real museum read: spot cones from ceiling cans, glass vitrines, placards, each stone's hue pooled on the floor; plinths themselves are near-black and the floor reflections are overly mirror-streaky.

Four hued tanks glow and tint the ceiling and floor, creatures read as remembered light; back wall stays flat dark teal-grey, tank light barely lands on walls, and a grey slab under the suit looks like a stray artifact.

top_issues.issue: Floor glow reads as blurry smears rather than light pools
top_issues.why: Long vertical reflection streaks and detached soft blobs look like screen-space artifacts; light should land as shaped pools under sources (cf. sconce pools in 08-vault).
top_issues.suggested_direction: Tame floor glossiness/roughness so reflections are short and soft; anchor each pool directly under its source and remove stray floating blobs.

top_issues.issue: Plinths and tank bases are nearly black silhouettes
top_issues.why: The spotlight hits the stone but the plinth below gets no light, so the showpiece loses its pedestal and the composition floats.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Let the spot cone graze the plinth top and front face, or add a small rim/uplight so the plinth reads as a dressed block.

top_issues.issue: Wing walls don't receive the showpiece light
top_issues.why: Brief asks tanks' living light to land on the room; the back wall between tanks stays a flat, mid-dark surface with little colour wash or structure.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Give each tank/vitrine a coloured wash on the wall behind it with falloff into dark gaps between, and surface structure (panels, ribs) that catches it.

top_issues.issue: Stray grey slab beneath the suit in the Vivarium
top_issues.why: Untextured grey quad in front of the centre tank reads as a bug and competes with the suit.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Either dress it as a lit placard with text or remove it.

top_issues.issue: Gallery stones are small inside oversized vitrines
top_issues.why: Gems lose presence at play scale; cut-stone facets are hard to read against bloom.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Scale stones up within cases or tighten vitrines; reduce bloom on the stone so facets read.
